# Editor sources

Blockbench by JannisX11 and contributors, GPL-3.0-or-later.
Official source: https://github.com/JannisX11/blockbench
License: https://github.com/JannisX11/blockbench/blob/master/LICENSE.MD
The local wrapper, CSS, fonts and assets were copied from this computer's installed Blockbench distribution. Its desktop bundle is not used; the wrapper loads the official web bundle from https://web.blockbench.net/dist/bundle.js. The Biome companion is authored separately and modifies no installed Blockbench files.

Piskel by the Piskel contributors, Apache-2.0.
Official embedding example: https://github.com/piskelapp/piskel-embed
Editor source: https://github.com/piskelapp/piskel
License: https://github.com/piskelapp/piskel/blob/master/LICENSE
The texture studio frames the official hosted example; it does not copy the Piskel code. Imported PNG pixels are saved locally in the course.

Minecraft reference assets: Mojang/Microsoft, imported from the local Minecraft 26.3 client cache. Full list and provenance: ../minecraft/provenance.json. These are local reference assets, not original Biome artwork. The biome-press-*.svg files and copper_plate.svg are original course artwork.

Three.js 0.186.1: official npm three package, MIT. The two unmodified browser
modules and license are vendored in three/.

Selected Minecraft Java 26.3 reference textures retain Mojang/Microsoft ownership.
Dimensions, internal resource paths, and SHA-256 hashes are in ../minecraft/provenance.json.
